scope: Read-only source collection for G4 job create/read, command read, authorization, persistence, and cursor planning. No source or tests were modified; no tests, database, service, or network were run.

locations: CREATE TABLE statements for memberships, catalog, jobs, delegations, artifacts, commands, outbox, workspace_intents

query.limit: Optional integer, minimum 1, maximum 100, original OpenAPI default 25.

GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}.success: 200 Snapshot, not bare Job; documented errors 401, 403, 409, 422.

CreateJob.type: object; additionalProperties=false; no property is nullable or has a default.

required_fields.title: string
required_fields.release_mode: string enum team_github_tag | shared_gerrit_change | shared_github_pr | shared_github_commit

CreateJob.additional_rules_from_B02: Body <=8 MiB; nesting <=64; reject duplicate JSON keys, invalid UTF-8, unknown keys and owner_id. Strings are nonempty; identifiers reject C0/DEL, request_text may retain newline/tab but not NUL. Preserve string values and array order without normalization; structured project_id is a Unicode scalar; input_artifact_ids must identify already-existing validated/available artifacts owned by the authenticated user and same project.

Job.type: object; additionalProperties=false; all listed fields required.

fields.owner_id: string, taken from authenticated user, never request payload

Job.initial_G4_values: status DRAFT, revision 0, cycle 0, current_step_ids [], candidate_fingerprint null; workflow_version comes from validated snapshot.payload.workflow.workflow_id and is ifpmic-sw-v1. profile_version is projected from the catalog label; job response must not add project_id or title.

fields.steps: array of objects; each requires step_id:string, cycle:integer>=0, attempt:integer>=0, state:string, detail:string, artifact_ids:string[]; no additional properties.

CommandReceipt.G4_initial_result: 202 with status accepted and resource_id equal to the new job ID; commit must succeed before response.

CommandStatus.G4_initial_result: Accepted commands report applied_revision null and error null.

Error.type: object; additionalProperties=false; fields code:string, message:string, trace_id:string; all required. B02 requires message equal to fixed code and server-generated UUID trace_id.

authorization_and_acceptance_rules.principal: Actor/owner is derived from the validated ax_session. Paperclip identity headers, body owner_id, project/admin role, local-board, worker or bridge credentials cannot impersonate a person.
authorization_and_acceptance_rules.create: Caller must have an active project membership whose capability includes request.create. The project/profile must be eligible; create body cannot mint memberships, eligibility, or profile JSON.
authorization_and_acceptance_rules.read: Caller must have active membership and be the job owner or have an unexpired, nonrevoked job.read delegation scoped to that exact job. Membership/delegation are checked on every query; project/company/operator administrators gain no implicit access. Missing and unauthorized job/command resources use the same 403 behavior to avoid existence disclosure. Lists return only visible rows.
authorization_and_acceptance_rules.atomic_acceptance: Capture immutable snapshot first. In one DB transaction serialize current membership and eligibility authority, then insert DRAFT job, accepted command with full semantic CreateJob text+digest, pending outbox, and RESERVED workspace intent. Unique(actor, canonical route, idempotency key) arbitrates races; same key/same body returns original receipt, same key/different body is 409. Replay rechecks current membership/ownership but does not revalidate the old profile or eligibility. Only commit permits 202; ambiguous commit returns 503 COMMIT_UNCERTAIN and same-key retry reconciles.
authorization_and_acceptance_rules.workflow: Job.workflow_version maps to the stable B01 workflow registry ID ifpmic-sw-v1; B01 schema_version 1.0.0 is format version and not workflow version. Raw source/state/agent/bundle hashes remain separately bound in the profile snapshot.
authorization_and_acceptance_rules.state_boundary: G4 leaves job DRAFT, command accepted, applied_revision null, error null, outbox pending and workspace intent RESERVED. B02 does not turn acceptance into execution. B03 Temporal remains authoritative for workflow transitions and outbox consumption.

current_database_support.memberships_and_serialization: memberships PK(project_id,user_id), active boolean, capabilities text[] constrained to request.create; authorization_guards row and triggers serialize membership/delegation/eligibility changes. Runtime can SELECT and UPDATE lock_version only; operator updates active/capabilities. This column-level grant supports scoped row locking without runtime authority mutation.
current_database_support.profiles: profile_catalog PK(project_id,version_key), unique project/snapshot and snapshot_id, immutable bytes/digest/label/mode/enabled/configuration_complete. Eligibility and revocation have project-scoped FKs; current catalog.import_snapshot can only import trusted B01 bridge records, is idempotent for exact bytes, rejects conflict, and does not grant eligibility. Runtime has SELECT only for catalog/grants.
current_database_support.jobs: UUID job_id; owner/project/snapshot/workflow_id; DRAFT/status check set, revision/cycle defaults and checks, current_step_ids, candidate_fingerprint; FK project/snapshot to catalog; UNIQUE(project_id,job_id); owner/status/created index. Runtime has SELECT and limited INSERT columns only; no UPDATE/DELETE on jobs.
current_database_support.delegations: delegation_id UUID, project_id/job_id/user_id, action constrained exactly job.read, expiry and nullable revocation; composite FK binds same project/job; trigger serializes with project authority guard. Operator may insert and update only expiry/revocation; runtime SELECT only.
current_database_support.artifacts: UUID ID, project, owner, nullable job, state pending|available|rejected, SHA256, nonnegative size; composite project/job FK. Runtime is SELECT-only; operator insert. B02 forbids pretending missing IDs exist, and artifact upload path is later scope.
current_database_support.commands: Command record binds authenticated actor, fixed route POST /api/v1/jobs, printable ASCII idempotency key length 1..128, project/job, ASCII command_payload_json, payload_sha256, status accepted|applied|rejected, nullable applied_revision/error_code; UNIQUE(actor,route,key), job_id unique, project/job FK and unique (command_id,job_id). Runtime has limited insert only; no status mutation in G4.
current_database_support.outbox_and_workspace: commands_outbox currently has command_id PK/FK, state pending|dispatched, created_at, and pending index; runtime may insert command_id only. workspace_intents binds one job and one command, has unique workspace_token, RESERVED|PROVISIONING|READY|ERROR, generation/claim/error fields and composite FK to command/job; runtime inserts job_id+command_id only and has column-limited updates for later reconciliation.
current_database_support.implementation_state: catalog.py provides immutable catalog import only. app.py currently exposes auth/login/callback/session/logout routes; no job-create, job-list, job-detail, or command-status routes exist. AuthService.authenticate returns a Session under the caller transaction and updates last_seen_at, providing the reusable authentication seam.

ambiguities_to_resolve_before_G4_impleme.issue: The route default cannot preserve both values. B02 calls pagination an added implementation contract, while the API contract says original route/DTO behavior remains; explicitly decide whether B02 intentionally overrides the original OpenAPI default before authoring tests.

sources: B02 G4 creates an initial DRAFT job and defers workflow transitions to B03
ambiguities_to_resolve_before_G4_impleme.issue: GET /jobs/{job_id} must return a Snapshot including last_event_id, but the current schema has neither event table nor a defined empty/initial event cursor. Define the G4 DRAFT response sentinel or add the appropriate event persistence contract; do not invent a value from DB implementation behavior.

sources: data-model.json commands_outbox fields command_id, scope, payload_hash, status, expected_revision
001_initial.sql commands_outbox fields command_id,state,created_at and command table stores route/hash/status
ambiguities_to_resolve_before_G4_impleme.issue: Clarify the intended mapping: G4 can create a pending outbox row and derive scope/hash/status/revision from commands, but the current table omits the conceptual fields scope, payload_hash, and expected_revision and names status as state. Confirm this is deliberate denormalization before B03 consumption is built.

sources: openapi.v1.json GET /api/v1/jobs exposes only cursor and limit
B02 says cursor binds actor and filter but defines no list filter parameters
ambiguities_to_resolve_before_G4_impleme.issue: Specify the filter tuple (currently none is defined) that the cursor binds, or clarify that only actor and canonical route are in the MAC context for this version.

implementation_constraints: Preserve exact required response DTO fields, nullability and additionalProperties=false from original OpenAPI; Job does not gain project_id/title.
No user-controlled owner, membership, delegation, grant, eligibility, profile content or workflow selector is accepted.

Do not weaken project/job ownership checks, artifact availability/ownership checks, idempotency uniqueness, transaction atomicity, immutable snapshot binding, fixed error DTOs, or current 001 privileges.
No table mutation or endpoint change is required by this source collection; any schema addition or API default reconciliation needs an explicit contract decision first.
